$comment: Vercel Hobby allows 2 cron jobs, each triggered once per day. Both slots are used.
Adding a third will fail deployment; adding a sub-daily schedule (e.g. */30 * * * *)
is rejected on Hobby. Wallet maintenance therefore runs all three of its jobs in one
pass, and stuck recharges are also settled lazily when a customer opens their wallet
so nobody waits a day for money they have already paid.
